title: Embedding quantization fingerprinting and weekly recalibration pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Build a reproducible fingerprinting + weekly recalibration pipeline for embedding quantization profiles (INT8 and FP16 / FP8 experiments) and automate cosine-similarity drift checks. Rationale: we have intermittent similarity regressions after quantized model rollouts; existing nightly calibration runs are ad-hoc and do not provide a compact fingerprint to quickly compare profiles between builds. This ticket delivers: (1) a deterministic embedding fingerprint artifact that summarizes distributional shifts across layers and corpus segments, (2) an automated weekly recalibration job that runs candidate quant profiles through holdout corpora, and (3) a gated alert + rollback policy when cosine-similarity metrics cross defined thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic fingerprint generator (embedding-fingerprint v1) produces a compact vector of scalar signals for any model+quant profile; artifacts stored in Artifacts bucket with stable naming
Weekly job (quant-fingerprint-weekly) runs against three holdout corpora and writes a drift report to Console; job configured in Airflow/K8s cron
Drift report computes mean cosine delta, 95th percentile delta, and recall@10 change for each corpus; thresholds: mean delta > 0.015 OR 95p delta > 0.045 OR recall@10 drop > 0.8% triggers P1 alert
Console shows historical fingerprint series with sparkline and a flagged window for any triggered alerts; engineers can drill into layer-level breakdowns and sample pairs
Automated canary gating: if production rollout causes fingerprint delta above thresholds, Dedicated rollout aborts and fallback to previous quant profile is executed via rollout policy
End-to-end tests: unit tests for fingerprint calculation, integration test that runs a small calibration dataset through INT8/FP16 quant and verifies fingerprints are reproducible within noise bounds
tasks: Design fingerprint schema: per-layer mean/std of activations, top-k singular-value energy ratio, token-length stratified cosine buckets
Implement embedding-fingerprint tool (Python) with reproducible RNG seeds and serialization to JSONL
Add dataset sampling helpers: spectral-anchor sampling and multi-corpus holdout selectors
Create Airflow DAG quant-fingerprint-weekly with staging, run, and report steps
Integrate drift detection into Console Alerts and add a per-profile dashboard
Add rollback hook into rollout controller to abort and switch to last good profile on gate failure
Write integration tests and nightly verification harness; wire results into CI artifacts
notes: Fingerprint focuses on compact, explainable signals rather than raw embeddings to make long-term trending practical
We will reuse embedding-sanity-runner code from ENG-30321 where possible but change sampling to spectral-anchor method to better surface corpus-specific regressions
FP8 experiments are exploratory — pipeline must support arbitrary quant formats but initial gating thresholds tuned for INT8/FP16
Thresholds above are provisional; set conservative values to avoid noisy alerts during initial rollout and iterate after two weeks of data
Potential follow-ups: integrate anomaly detector to suggest which tokens or layer positions drive the drift and a small sample oracle that runs float32 for the top-100 flagged queries
